steps.en: The owner's mobile number is fetched from the government database
steps.id: Nomor mobile pemilik diambil dari database pemerintah
steps.why_en: This refresh is switched off everywhere, so older stored numbers are used.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan ini dimatikan di mana-mana, jadi nomor lama yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each individual owner is counted once, with all their notices combined
steps.id: Tiap pemilik individu dihitung sekali, semua notice-nya digabung

steps.en: The SMS lists the unpaid notices and mentions the first letter
steps.id: SMS memuat notice yang belum dibayar dan menyebut letter pertama
steps.why_en: The message wording is stored outside the code, so the reference to the first letter cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Redaksi pesan disimpan di luar code, jadi rujukan ke letter pertama tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: All SMS go out in one batch and the result is saved
steps.id: Semua SMS dikirim dalam satu batch dan hasilnya dicatat
steps.why_en: SMS sending is switched off in production, and the daily run is inactive in every environment.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman SMS dimatikan di production, dan jadwal harian tidak aktif di semua environment.
